name: WF9 - Weekly Review Requests to Converted Students

parameters.query: SELECT l.id as lead_id, l.name, l.phone, l.brand, l.client_id, c.phone_number_id, c.wa_access_token FROM leads l JOIN clients c ON l.client_id = c.id WHERE l.status = 'converted' AND l.converted_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '45 days' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND l.id NOT IN (SELECT CAST(action_data->>'lead_id' AS INTEGER) FROM sheriff_actions WHERE action_type = 'review_request' AND executed_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND action_data->>'lead_id' IS NOT NULL) AND l.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone_number_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 20

parameters.jsCode:
const student = $input.first().json;

// Brand-specific review messages
const messages = {
  'BM Academy': `Hi ${student.name}! 😊

Hope your digital marketing journey is going well!

We would love to hear about your experience at BM Academy. A 2-minute Google review from you helps other students like you find us.

⭐ Leave a review here:
https://g.page/r/BM_ACADEMY_REVIEW_LINK

Thank you so much! 🙏
— BM Academy Team`,
  'BM TechX': `Hi ${student.name}! 👋

We hope you are seeing great results from our digital marketing work for your business!

Would you spare 2 minutes to share your experience on Google? It means the world to us.

⭐ Google Review:
https://g.page/r/BMTECHX_REVIEW_LINK

Thank you! 🙏
— BM TechX Team`,
  'EduConsultants': `Hi ${student.name}! 🌍

Hope your MBBS journey is going well!

Could you take 2 minutes to leave us a Google review? It helps other students and parents find trusted guidance.

⭐ Review us here:
https://g.page/r/EDUCONSULTANTS_REVIEW_LINK

Thank you so much! 🙏`
};

const msg = messages[student.brand] || `Hi ${student.name}! Would you leave us a Google review? It means a lot! https://g.page/r/ABM_REVIEW_LINK`;

return [{ json: { ...student, message: msg } }];
